data_fields.name: live_like_burst_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: false (NPC bosses do not burst when true)

best_idea: A boss burst is one timer that first runs as the burst length and then as the rest period, gated by an HP fraction; while it runs every frontal melee hit is ripostes, and each boss's abilities are a data row of id, level and up to nine numeric parameters.
decision_why: Take the one-timer burst window, the HP gate and the data row format, but count the rest from the scheduled end and spend a pull cooldown only when a target exists; the riposte effect becomes a server-verified guard-style parry state, not a per-client roll.
acceptance: A server test: a boss at or below 9 percent HP starts a 10 s burst in which every frontal melee hit ripostes with no damage; the next burst cannot start before 360 s after the scheduled end even when the 1 s poll runs late; a pull with no hate-top does not start its cooldown.
